bi-connect.name: BI Connect
bi-connect.description: Get a complete, always up-to-date view of your studio's performance through 70+ interactive dashboards covering bookings, revenue, client retention, instructor performance, and more — all in one place, updated daily.

data-as-a-service.name: Data as a Service
data-as-a-service.description: Connect your bsport data directly to the Business Insights or analytics tools your team already uses for deeper, fully custom analyses beyond the standard dashboards.

access-control.name: Access Control
access-control.description: Automate studio access by letting members open doors directly from the app, eliminating the need for reception staff and ensuring only eligible members can enter.

fiskaly-twint.name: Local Compliance & Payments
fiskaly-twint.description: Support regional requirements out of the box: TSE fiscal compliance (Germany) or Twint payments (Switzerland). So your studio stays legally covered and payment-ready in your market.

branded-app.name: Branded App
branded-app.description: Give members a booking experience that looks and feels like your studio — fully customised with your colors, logo, and name, on iOS and Android.
